chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them:

Regarding a man who entrusted another man with two dinars, and another entrusted him with one dinar, then one dinar out of them was lost, he said: "The owner of the two dinars is to be given one dinar, and they are to divide the remaining dinar equally between themselves into two halves."

key_terms.اسْتَوْدَعَ: entrusted something to another for safekeeping
key_terms.دِينَارًا: a single dinar, whether deposited or returned
key_terms.دِينَارَيْنِ: two dinars deposited by one owner

ai.seo_question: How should lost entrusted money be divided between two depositors in Shi'i fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a disputed loss in entrusted property. When two people deposit unequal amounts and one unit is lost without specification, the remaining property is distributed in a way that accounts for both certainty and shared uncertainty.
